summary_md: **恒星sun ([@vintcessun](https://x.com/vintcessun/status/2116074386742767984))** explains *Eat Your Precision* ([arXiv 2610.33512](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33512)): rubric-coverage rewards push models to pad answers with redundant or wrong content, so FORK splits answers into units, judges necessity and correctness and optimizes an Fβ-style objective, lifting medical-benchmark win rates from about 11% to 68% and 22% to 74%, though necessity still relies on an LLM grader.

referenced_urls.title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking...

relevance: Reward-hacking mitigation for rubric-based RL, relevant to training reasoning models.
